title: Death of man in police custody probed
subtitle: An inquest has been announced into the death of a Niagara Falls man while in police custody.
article: An inquest has been announced into the death of a Niagara Falls man while in police custody.
Orlando Rotolo died in July, 2007 at Greater Niagara General Hospital following an early-morning incident in the parking lot of a restaurant.
Rotolo, 29 called police and claimed he was being chased, then ran away himself officers reported.
Police said he was taken into custody, then went into mental distress and was taken to hospital.
The Ontario Special Investigations Unit looked into the incident.
The inquest begins April 26 and will examine the events surrounding Rotolo's death with the jury possibly making recommendations to prevent similar deaths.
